pins.head: STORAGE YOU CAN SIT ON
pins.title: Small Apartment: Pick Storage You Can Also Sit On or Set a Cup On
pins.desc: In a small living room every piece has to do two jobs. A storage ottoman takes blankets and is a footrest, a lidded basket hides the clutter and is a side table, and neither needs a wall. Swap one single-purpose piece at a time and the floor opens up. Contains affiliate links. #SmallApartment #StorageOttoman #BudgetDecor
pins.alt: A fabric storage ottoman and a large lidded wicker basket beside a grey sofa with patterned cushions and a throw, with woven bins on a shelf behind.

pins.head: KEEP A SHEET ON THE COUNTER
pins.sub: Patches Where You Will Use Them
pins.title: Acne Patches: Keep One Sheet Out Where You Wash Your Face
pins.desc: A box of patches in a drawer gets forgotten. One sheet left by the sink gets used the night you need it, and the rest of the box stays sealed and clean. Buy the size you reach for most and keep the spare sheets flat so the edges do not lift. Contains affiliate links. #AcnePatches #SkincareRoutine #BathroomCounter
pins.alt: A faint sheet of small clear hydrocolloid patches and an empty ceramic dish on a white bathroom counter by a bright window, with a folded towel on the shelf behind.

pins.head: SPARE ROLLS GO IN A BASKET
pins.title: Small Bathroom: A Lidded Floor Basket Holds the Backup Supplies
pins.desc: Spare rolls and refills do not need a cabinet. A tall woven basket on the floor beside the vanity holds them out of sight, slides out of the way to clean, and costs a fraction of any built-in. Keep the everyday things on the counter and the spares in the basket. Contains affiliate links. #BathroomStorage #StorageBaskets #RenterFriendly
pins.alt: A wooden vanity with a sink and soap bottles, a slim white rolling cart and a tall woven basket on the floor beside it, with a shelf of towels and baskets over the toilet.

pins.head: REMOVABLE FOR WALLS YOU RENT
pins.title: Permanent or Removable Vinyl: Pick by Where the Decal Will Live
pins.desc: A wall decal in a rental has to come off without taking the paint with it, so it gets removable vinyl. A mug, a tumbler or an outdoor sign has to survive washing and weather, so it gets permanent. Decide where the decal lives before you buy the roll. Contains affiliate links. #CricutProjects #AdhesiveVinyl #VinylDecals
pins.alt: Two rolls of adhesive vinyl, one terracotta and one cream, on a wooden craft table, with the edge of a cut leaf decal beside them.

pins.head: A TRAY TAKES A BIGGER KIT
pins.title: 32 oz Two-Part Epoxy Resin Kit for Projects Bigger Than a Coaster
pins.desc: Work out the volume of the mold before you order and the kit size picks itself. A 32 oz kit, resin and hardener in two bottles, covers a tray or a set of coasters with some left for the mistakes, which is cheaper than running out halfway and mixing a second batch. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #EpoxyResin #ResinSupplies
pins.alt: Two bottles of resin and hardener beside graduated measuring cups and a notepad with a pencil on a wooden table by a window.

pins.head: ONE DRAWER FOR THE SMALL STUFF
pins.title: Small Home Office: A Desktop Drawer Box Clears the Small Clutter
pins.desc: Pens, chargers and sticky notes are what make a small desk look messy, not the laptop. A little drawer box on the desk gives them one place to go, holds a cup of pens on top, and takes up less room than the pile it replaces. Contains affiliate links. #HomeOffice #DeskOrganization #WorkFromHome
pins.alt: A light wood desk with a file sorter, a small wooden drawer box holding pens and a laptop on a wooden stand, with a teal chair, a lamp and a plant by the window.

pins.head: ONE NUMBERED CORK PER FIGURE
pins.title: Miniature Painting: Mount Each Figure on a Numbered Cork
pins.desc: Holding a miniature by its base rubs the primer off the edges. Stick each one to a wine cork, number the corks, and you can turn, paint and set down a figure without touching it, and keep track of which one has had which coat. Contains affiliate links. #MiniaturePainting #Wargaming #PaintingTips
pins.alt: Four grey primed miniature figures mounted on numbered wine corks on a green cutting mat, with a grey spray can and a paint brush behind.

pins.head: SORT THE RAIL BY COLOR
pins.title: Tiny Closet: Hang Everything in Color Order So You Can See It All
pins.desc: In a small closet you cannot pull things out to look at them, so the rail has to do the work. Hang everything by color, light to dark, and you see what you own in one glance, spot what is missing and stop buying the third grey shirt. Contains affiliate links. #ClosetOrganization #SmallCloset #RenterFriendly
pins.alt: An open closet with shirts hung in color order on two rails, woven baskets along the top shelf, a hanging fabric shelf and clear shoe boxes on the floor.

pins.head: POWDER OR PODS, PER LOAD
pins.sub: Price per Load, Not per Box
pins.title: Laundry Detergent: Compare Powder and Pods by the Price per Load
pins.desc: Powder is usually the cheapest per load and pods cost the most but cannot be over-poured. Liquid sits in between. Work out which loads you run most, divide the price by the number of loads on the box rather than its weight, and the format choice gets simple. Contains affiliate links. #LaundryRoom #LaundryTips #HouseholdEssentials
pins.alt: A small open box of laundry powder with a scoop and a glass jar of laundry pods with a cork lid on a light wood shelf, with folded towels behind.

pins.head: POCKETS HANG OVER THE DOOR
pins.title: Renter Storage: An Over-the-Door Pocket Organizer Adds Storage Without Holes
pins.desc: The back of a door is the biggest empty surface in most rentals. A pocket organizer that hooks over the top holds shoes, scarves or cleaning supplies, needs no screws, and comes off with the door untouched on moving day. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #OverTheDoor #SmallSpaceStorage
pins.alt: A clear pocket organizer hanging on the back of an open door next to a closet of clothes, with a white rolling cart of yarn and art supplies and a grey sofa in a bright room.

pins.head: PODS FOR THE BUSY MORNINGS
pins.title: Flavored Coffee Pod Variety Pack for Weekday Mornings
pins.desc: Pods cost more per cup than a bag, so use them where they earn it: the rushed weekday cups. A variety pack lets you find the flavors you actually finish before committing to a full box of one, and the bag of beans covers the slow weekend pots. Contains affiliate links. #CoffeePods #CoffeeAtHome #PantryPlanning
pins.alt: A pile of coffee pods in assorted colors beside a plain kraft coffee bag, a calculator and a notepad on a light wood kitchen counter.

pins.head: OPEN BINS, NOT A TIGHT SHELF
pins.title: Under the Sink: Open Bins You Can Lift Out Beat a Fixed Shelf
pins.desc: A fixed shelf under the sink never quite clears the drain pipe. Two open bins on a mat sit either side of it, lift out whole when you need the bottle at the back, and catch a drip before it reaches the cabinet floor. Contains affiliate links. #UnderSinkStorage #KitchenOrganization #SmallKitchen
pins.alt: An open teal sink cabinet with the drain pipe in the middle and two cream bins of cleaning bottles and sponges on a mat either side, with a wooden cart at the left.
